title: FOIA request for USAF Campinas flight records answered by the CIA

tellings.quote: our team we filed a foyer and uh in in 2022, I think it was.

plain: In about 2022, a team led by James Fox asked the US Air Force for records of its flights connected to Campinas, a city in Brazil, starting from 1996. They used the Freedom of Information Act, a US law that lets anyone request government records, and the answer came back from the CIA, not the Air Force. Fox says he took part in this himself. He tells it because the CIA answering a question about Air Force flights suggests that something more than a routine flight happened there.
